aboutText: Julyan Cassidy is a certified Horticulturist and Landscape Designer, serving Brunswick West since 2016. After leaving an unfulfilling IT career, he established Sir Plantsalot to deliver tailored garden maintenance and landscape design. With a focus on sustainability and personal connection, Julyan works closely with each client to transform outdoor spaces. He specialises in smaller spaces, using sustainable materials and retaining existing features to enhance local character.
servicesText: Sir Plantsalot offers comprehensive garden maintenance and landscape design services in Brunswick West. We specialise in sustainable practices, creating outdoor spaces that reflect your vision. From regular upkeep to complete transformations, our solutions are tailored to your needs.
